summary: Verified Sep 15 2026 follow-up bug fixes on Confirmed Production report (/production-confirmation/confirmed-report). All 4 previously-blank columns now render correctly. Backend curl + code review + frontend visual verification all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: log_confirmation() fallback logic verified in production_confirmation_service.py line ~158-162: byproduct_qty falls back to new_byproduct_confirmed_quantity; byproduct_unit falls back to new_byproduct_unit_code. Correct.

server.py /production-confirmation/confirmed-report endpoint correctly live-fetches missing descriptions via sap_material_client.resolve_material_info and caches them into component_master (idempotent upsert).

ConfirmProductionRequest (line 2790-2791) and FinishTaskRequest (line 3269-3270) both accept optional production_model_id + reporting_point_description; endpoint passes both into log_confirmation payload (line 3332-3333).
Frontend ProductionConfirmationPage.js submit() line 305-306 and finishTaskOnly() line 428-429 correctly send production_model_id + reporting_point_description sourced from the row.

verification_evidence.backend_api_curl: GET /api/production-confirmation/confirmed-report returned 44 rows. All 44 rows have main_output_product_description populated (was previously null for many). reporting_point_description + production_model_id keys are present in every row (null for old pre-fix data as expected). 17/44 rows have byproduct_confirmed_quantity>0 including Lot 70570 RP_10 = 1.304 KGM (spec confirmed).
verification_evidence.frontend_table_headers: Exactly 14 columns in exact order: Date/Time, Lot ID, Output Product, Description, Reporting Point, Model ID, Site, Confirmed Qty, UOM, Scrap, By-product Qty, By-product Unit, WIP Clearing, Confirmed By.
verification_evidence.description_column_populated: Real product names visible in screenshot: 'Rear Arm Tube', 'Bracket', 'Bottom Plate', 'Wall Plate', 'BRACKET, TANGENT', 'PLATE, FRONT', 'Tv Arm Left', 'ONN FIXED MNT 32"-86"' - live SAP backfill working.
verification_evidence.model_id_gracefully_dashed: Model ID shows '—' for all pre-fix rows without crashing.
verification_evidence.byproduct_row_verified: Lot 70570 RP_10 shows By-product Qty=1.3 / Unit=KGM in table. Other rows (70566, 70563, 70538, 70545) also show correct KGM by-product data.
verification_evidence.excel_export_columns: Code review of ConfirmedProductionPage.js line 86-92 confirms Excel export header includes 'Reporting Point' and 'Model ID' columns in same order as table.

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only verification against real production_confirmation_history docs (Lots 73348, 73309, 73314, 73304, 73279, 70570, etc.). No writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 174 verified the Production module page-split; iteration 175 (this one) verified the follow-up 4-column data fix on /production-confirmation/confirmed-report. Both passed 100%. reporting_point_description + production_model_id will remain '—' for all pre-Sep-15-2026 history rows (cannot be retroactively recovered); they will only populate for NEW confirmations posted after the fix. Do NOT trigger real SAP Confirm POSTs to verify - destructive.
rca of the issue: N/A - fixes already in place and verified working. RCA per problem statement: (1) Description missing because component_master wasn't populated for many Sub-Assembly/Finished codes (only categorization/BOM paths seeded it). Fixed with on-demand SAP fetch + cache. (2) reporting_point_description + production_model_id never persisted in history collection. Fixed by adding fields to request models + log_confirmation. (3) By-product qty/unit lost on auto-create path because log_confirmation only read the existing-line fields. Fixed with fallback to new_byproduct_* fields.
